messages:
Sam: Quick sync — nl-east cutover tomorrow 0800 UTC. Need final signoffs on routing ACLs, KMS key policy, and residency config. Owners: routing=Priya, infra=Marco, security=Anita. Any blockers?

Priya: Routing config ready, uploaded to repo, PR #422. Need IAM role for proxy to access peering VPN.

Marco: Infra ok. VM images baked. Need KMS key alias from Security to set up disk encryption.

Anita: Reviewing KMS policy now. Legal asked for explicit data-residency clause for EU edge. Pinged @legal for quick confirm.

Priya: @Marco can you add this ACL to cloud router? ```allow tcp 443 from 10.0.0.0/16 to 100.64.0.0/12``` will be needed for internal health checks.

Marco: I can add but need service account arn. @Priya which SA?

Priya: Use sa-routing-nl-east@redwood-prod.ipa

Anita: KMS policy tweak ready — adding condition: aws:ResourceTag/residency=europe. Attaching snippet: ```"Condition": {"StringEquals":{"aws:ResourceTag/residency":"europe"}}```

Legal: quick confirm — clause is fine, need to add retention clause to infra playbook. Assigning @Jess to update playbook.

Jess: Will update playbook and push PR by EOD.

Sam: Canary plan — start with 5% traffic for first 30m, monitor latency and errors. If >2% errors rollback. Owners: canary=Marco, monitoring=Yusuf.

Yusuf: Dashboards added. Alert: nl-east 95p latency > 120ms and error rate > 1%.

Marco: Noted. I'll watch during canary.

Priya: Small ask — QA needs domain for smoke test. @dns-team any chance of pre-provision?

DNS-bot: Created CNAME smoke-nl-east.redwood-internal -> routing-elb-nl-east (ttl=60).

Sam: Cool. final items: security signoff (Anita) + legal signoff (Legal) + infra runbook link in PR. If all good, cutover at 0800 UTC.

Anita: Security signoff done. Marking PR with :white_check_mark:

Legal: done, added retention note. :thumbsup:

Sam: Thanks all — i'll kick the runbook at 0800 and ping on #oncall. If any late blockers call me.
